t: The Matter of Soul: From Turing Machines to Sovereign AI
s: This essay explores the journey from basic matter to consciousness, framing life as a hierarchy of Turing machines and advocating for "Enchanted Materialism." It then discusses strategies for human co-existence with AI, emphasizing "machine diplomats" and the "Pipulate" sovereignty engine to safeguard human agency through scientific optimism.
sub: Enchanted Materialism & Emergence of Consciousness from Matter
Life's Evolution as Hierarchy of Turing Machines (Endosymbiosis, Nervous System, Brain as UI)
Language as External Data Processing & Collective Meta-intelligence
Designing for AI Coexistence: Machine Diplomats & 'Pipulate' Sovereignty Engine
